description: Add instructor learner-preview mode that lets an instructor simulate the learner journey for any of their modules. The instructor can enter a preview mode that shows the full learner experience (guided activities, AI coach, assessment) without affecting real learner data.
steps: 1. In src/lib/domain/types.ts, add a PreviewMode type or flag interface: { active: boolean; moduleId: string; instructorId: string }.

2. In src/components/providers.tsx, add preview mode state: (a) isPreviewMode boolean, (b) previewModuleId string|null, (c) enterPreviewMode(moduleId: string) function, (d) exitPreviewMode() function. When preview mode is active, the learner components should render using the preview module's data. Preview mode state should be separate from the instructor's normal state.

3. Create src/components/instructor/learner-preview.tsx: A wrapper component that (a) shows a prominent banner at the top indicating 'PREVIEW MODE - Simulating Learner View' with an 'Exit Preview' button, (b) renders the full learner flow (module overview -> guided activities -> AI coach -> assessment -> readiness report) using the selected module's data, (c) any assessment answers in preview mode are discarded on exit (not persisted).

4. Add a 'Preview as Learner' button in the instructor's module management area (either in the dashboard or module config). This button calls enterPreviewMode(moduleId) and switches the view to the learner-preview component.

5. In src/components/main-router.tsx, add logic: if role is 'instructor' AND isPreviewMode is true, render the LearnerPreview component instead of the normal instructor views. When the instructor exits preview, return to their normal instructor dashboard.

6. Ensure preview mode works with both the electrical and CS modules - the preview renders the correct module's activities, questions, and competencies based on which module the instructor chose to preview.
7. Add 'preview' to the instructor sub-navigation or add it as a new InstructorView option. The preview tab only appears when preview mode is active.
acceptance_criteria: Instructor can click 'Preview as Learner' from their dashboard or module config
Preview mode shows a clear banner indicating it is a simulation
Preview mode renders the full learner journey (overview, activities, coach, assessment, report)
Preview mode uses the selected module's data (works for both electrical and CS modules)
Exiting preview mode returns to the instructor dashboard
Assessment answers in preview mode are not persisted after exit
